erin (Docs): quick thread — i'm polishing the Optimize toolkit guide and we still have a few loose ends: a Rust snippet landed that uses the old sync API, the quant table wording is too definitive for embeddings, and we need a short migration note for multimodal inputs + batching. can eng/ML sanity-check?
sam (Eng): paste the Rust snippet here and the YAML cell you want to ship. i'll run it in the examples repo.
erin (Docs): Rust snippet that landed: 
```rust
// current (problematic) example in PR
let resp = client.generate_sync("redwood/fast-ggml", prompt, 256).unwrap();
println!("{}", resp.text);
```
quant YAML cell in doc: 
```yaml
quant_profiles:
  - id: q8_0
    recommended: true
    notes: "good cost tradeoff"
```
yuki (Runtime): runtime + SDK v2: generate_sync was removed in the Rust SDK. use the async API `client.generate().await` or the batch.request helper for batched inputs. for multimodal requests (image + text) batching semantics differ — images increase memory so prefer `max_batch_size: 1` or route to a dedicated pool. also add `cache.prefetch` guidance when the textual prefix repeats across multimodal calls.
dani (ML): re: quant wording, please don't state "recommended: true" for q8_0 unconditionally. for embeddings q8_0 can be good cost-wise but may exhibit drift on smaller dimension embeddings; suggest language: "q8_0: cost-efficient; run embedding drift checks (1k samples) before adopting." for generation advise q4_0 for fidelity-sensitive tasks.
sam (Eng): suggested Rust replacement snippet (async) i'm testing: 
```rust
// replacement: async + batch.request
let resp = client.batch_request(&[prompt.to_string()], Some(256)).await?;
println!("{}", resp[0].text);
```
also added a tiny Rust prefetch example (pseudocode): 
```rust
// prefetch textual prefixes (pseudocode)
client.cache().prefetch(vec!["session_prefix_v3"]).await?;
let resp = client.generate(...).await?;
```
ci-bot: docs-lint: broken link in PR #912 -> /docs/sdk/rust/generate_sync (404) :warning:
erin (Docs): thanks. i'll update the quant YAML to the softer wording and add the Rust async example + prefetch snippet. also want a one-line migration checklist entry: "search for generate_sync, batch.create, old streaming helpers".
yuki (Runtime): add a callout about multimodal batching: "If your request includes an image, prefer per-request small batch sizes or use dedicated image-capable routes — otherwise memory pressure can force fallback and increase latency." also suggest a short note about KV prefetch memory tradeoff when prefetching many unique prefixes.
dani (ML): adding a tiny eval snippet to PR comments: run 1k random pairs for embeddings and compute cosine drift between fp32 baseline and quantized profile; include threshold guidance.
erin (Docs): perfect. i've pushed a small PR #913 with the Rust fix, prefetch snippet, quant wording change, and migration checklist. tagging @eng for quick sign-off.
ci-bot: docs-lint passed for PR #913 :white_check_mark:
sam (Eng): quick LGTM, merging after one small nits fix. thanks team.
erin (Docs): merged and added changelog entry: "Optimize: Rust SDK snippets updated; clarified quant guidance for embeddings; multimodal batching note; KV prefetch advisory." closing thread. :tada:
